entities.summary: Sean Simon Andrew Fraser is a Canadian lawyer and politician who is the minister of justice and Attorney General of Canada. A member of the Liberal Party, Fraser has served as the member of Parliament (MP) for Central Nova since 2015. He joined Cabinet in 2021 as the minister of immigration, refugees and citizenship, and was the minister of housing, infrastructure and communities from 2023 to 2024. Fraser took on his current role in 2025 and concurrently minister for the Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency.
